descriptionMarkdown:
Action Effect
Drive Hard
Driver: move up to the vehicle’s Speed again. Once per vehicle per round. Until the driver’s next 
turn, attacks from it have disadvantage and targets have advantage on saves against its mounted 
area weapons.
Evasive Driving
Driver: declare before vehicle movement; cap that movement at half Speed. Until the driver’s next 
turn, attacks against the hull have disadvantage and it has advantage on Dexterity saves. Attacks 
from it have disadvantage; targets have advantage on saves against its mounted area weapons. 
Cannot combine with Drive Hard.
Fire a Mount At its station, make one mounted attack or use one mounted area weapon. Extra Attack does not 
add shots. Each mount can fire only once per round, including reactions.
Reload a Mount At its station or loader position, reload one mount. Each mount can be reloaded only once per 
round.
Spot or Assist Use Help to give one ally advantage on their next driving check or mounted attack before your next 
turn. A useful view, communication and plausible assistance are required.
Damage Control At the affected system: action and DC 13 Intelligence (Technology) check to clear one weapon 
jam, engine stall or vehicle fire. Restores no HP.
One action cannot both drive and fire. A one-crew vehicle can move normally and fire using its driver’s action, but 
cannot Drive Hard and fire that turn. Readying a mount uses Ready and a reaction; its once-per-round limit still applies. 
An explicitly granted additional action may fire a different mount that the operator can access.
Mounted attack = d20 + Dexterity modifier + proficiency if proficient in Vehicles or that weapon. Add Dexterity to 
damage once on a hit. Mounted save DC = 8 + Dexterity modifier + proficiency if trained. Area weapons add no ability 
modifier to damage. A mount removes normal Heavy and Emplaced movement restrictions; other properties still apply. 
Personal-weapon-only features do not automatically apply to mounts.
Turret mounts fire in any direction; forward mounts fire in a 90-degree arc centred on the hull’s front. Terrain and the 
hull still block line of fire. Vehicle movement counts as occupant movement for Accurate and other “did not move” 
benefits. Personal weapons retain their normal rules, including Extra Attack; they do not use Fire a Mount.
Closed compartments provide Full Cover from outside attacks and effects that cannot pass through the hull. Open-
topped vehicles and exposed riders provide Light Cover where the hull blocks the line of fire. Using a hatch or firing 
port exposes that occupant with Heavy Cover until their next turn. One occupant uses each firing port per round. Target 
a visible occupant using their own AC. Hull hits do not also hit the crew.
Area effects resolve separately against the hull and exposed occupants in the area. Full Cover protects enclosed 
occupants unless an effect penetrates it. Vehicle Strength saves use +2 for Large, +4 for Huge or +6 for Gargantuan; 
Constitution saves use +4. Dexterity saves use the driver’s Dexterity (Vehicles) modifier + Handling. An uncontrolled or 
immobilised vehicle automatically fails Dexterity saves.
